title: us-evolution-education-lpm Synthetic Curriculum-Redesign Record
description: A PROPOSED, hypothetical redesign of a real curriculum/assessment object -- new or restructured benchmark content that does NOT exist in official the relevant federal body/State Board of Education guidance today -- reachable from the real baseline by changing one explicit theoretical commitment (an 'adjacent possible' curriculum, not an arbitrary invention). This is a third, weaker-still tier below coherence-finding-record (verifiable textual fact about existing policy) and latent-connection-record (a reinterpretive lens on existing, UNCHANGED content, never a claim about what the relevant federal body's own text asserts or requires): this schema proposes content that would need to be ADDED or CHANGED to exist. Never conflate the three. A synthetic-curriculum-redesign-record must never be cited in briefs/ or any the relevant federal body/school-district-facing material as describing real, adopted policy -- see GOVERNANCE.md's synthetic-content rule. Identical shape to deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's synthetic-curriculum-redesign-record.schema.json.

status.description: This record's own review pipeline -- how much scrutiny the PROPOSAL itself has received. Never conflate with contentStatus below, which is about what KIND of claim the record makes, not how reviewed it is.

contentStatus.description: Single-value by design, same rationale as deutsche_lp's identical field: every record under this schema IS a synthetic redesign proposal by construction.

baselineCurriculumObject.description: The single, real, unchanged policy/curriculum object this redesign starts from.

accessTier.description: How much of the REAL baseline's source document this record actually keeps in excerptText, chosen per-source based on what's legally safe to redistribute for this document -- not one all-or-nothing repo-wide rule. Same four values and meaning as coherence-finding-record.schema.json's identical field. Applies only to baselineCurriculumObject's real, quoted starting point -- proposedRedesign is this repo's own invented content and carries no source-rights question. Optional; a baselineCurriculumObject without this field predates 2026-09-30 and should be treated as 'excerpt-only' at most until reviewed.

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal basis for storing excerptText at the accessTier chosen above. Mirrors OpenLPM's standards_documents.license_or_rights_note field (openlpm migration 019) for ecosystem-wide naming consistency.

externalDatasetRef.description: Optional pointer into a real external dataset this repo doesn't own but reads directly, e.g. 'bio-core-k12/strands/strand-102-natural-selection-adaptation.yaml' or a specific CompetencyBase id.

theoreticalGrounding.description: The explicit theoretical commitment that generates this redesign from the real baseline -- required, per the same discipline as deutsche_lp: a redesign not traceable to a specific TheoryBase claim is undisciplined brainstorming, not this schema's job.

theorybaseTheory.description: The real TheoryBase Theory id whose commitment this redesign applies.

changedCommitment.description: Plain-language statement of exactly what theoretical commitment changes between the real baseline and this redesign -- one named variable changes, not an unconstrained rewrite.

relatedRealCompetencyIds.description: Real CompetencyBase/ConceptBase ids this new/changed element builds on or cross-references.

costs.description: What the real baseline does well that this redesign risks losing or complicating. Required, not optional.
